# CV example: Returning to work

## Sarah Ferguson

Phone number: 07836994288

Email: s.ferguson@email.co.uk

Address: 4 Deemount Terrace, Aberdeen, AB11 7RX

Experienced in the financial services sector, I have a top-class understanding of accounting principles, financial record keeping and transaction management. I've educated myself on sector developments through formal and informal learning opportunities. I'm a highly-motivated professional who is very organised with good attention to detail.

### Skills

- Able to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
- Fast and accurate when dealing with figures
- Able to work well as part of a team
- Honest and dependable
- Excellent communication and people skills
- Good IT skills: Word, Excel, Sage
- Well-developed customer care skills

#### Achievements

#### Nominated for a Scottish Financial Services Award in the 'Net Zero' category

I was nominated for my work at Impact Bank. In this role, I streamlined the invoicing process, making it entirely paperless which helped reduce carbon emissions. This work was recognised as having a significant positive impact toward the company's green strategy.

#### Work experience

#### Accounts Assistant at Impact Bank

Processing purchase invoices in the Sage 200 accounting system. Ensuring 3-way matching electronically of purchase orders, receipts and purchase invoices. Validating outstanding purchase orders and invoice queries. Carrying out supplier statement reconciliations. Resolving invoice complaints and queries with suppliers. Making sure all invoices are authorised. Performing regular housekeeping checks and making sure ledgers are tidy. Dealing with auditor requests.

#### Trainee Accounts Assistant at Jack Smith Motor Group, Aberdeen

#### Teller/Clerical Officer (Voluntary) at Credit Union Limited, Aberdeen

#### Trainee Accounts Assistant at Jack Smith Motor Group, Aberdeen

#### Education and training

#### Return to Financial Services Programme at Lochside Training

#### HNC Accounting (with Financial Services) at North East Scotland College

#### Additional information

I'm a swimming coach at West Amateur Swim Club. In July 2022, I achieved a UKCC Level 1 Award Coaching Swimming. Having raced for the club myself as a teenager, I love mentoring and coaching the young swimmers
